forum.title: Voltage information on PA0 for STM32N657X0H3Q
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Harsh\_Bhavsar

GPIO PA0 is in the VDD domain (like PA1), and the Notes column should contain “(1)”.

In addition, PA0 is a TT\_a structure, as it provides an analog connection to the ADC.

I have requested a correction of this table for the next revision. The internal ticket number : CDM0061970 (This is an internal tracking number and is not accessible or usable by customers.)

Sorry for this typo.

Best regards,

Romain,
forum.content_text:
Hello Team,

We are using STM32N657X0H3Q for one of our application, while looking for the voltage level information for pins, we did not get any information for PA0 pin for the controller, specifically i am referring the notes column in pin description section.

I hope you are getting my question.

Regards

Harsh Bhavsar

forum.author: Harsh_Bhavsar

scraped_replies.html:
Reading datasheets is a skill you might want to improve.

The answer you look for is in the explanation of "TT_a" in the column "I/O structure".
This is found in a table "Legend/abbreviations used in the pinout table", usually at the beginning of the pinout section.
